name: Strip
summary: Buy 2 ATM puts and 1 ATM call at the same strike and expiry; a long straddle weighted bearish.

legs.strike_rule: SAME ATM strike as the puts

when_to_use: IV rank < 25 with a catalyst and a downside lean. Note that put skew makes the 2 long puts relatively expensive, so the strip usually costs more than the strap on the same strike - factor that into the expected-move math.
max_profit: very large to the downside (2x the slope of a straddle); unlimited but single-weighted to the upside
max_loss: net debit paid, at the strike. Defined.
breakevens: downside = strike - debit/200; upside = strike + debit/100

greeks.delta: negative at entry, approximately -50 per unit

entry_rules: IV rank < 25; reject if IV rank >= 35.
All three contracts on the identical ATM strike and expiry.
Total debit <= 1% of equity per unit.
A dated catalyst inside the expiry.
ATM OI >= 1000, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 8% of mid).
Single 3-contract multi-leg order at mid, pay up to mid + $0.03.
management_rules: Close at 50% gain on the debit, or the session after the catalyst, whichever first.
Time stop: close if 40% of the time to expiry has elapsed with no move beyond 0.75 expected moves.
Hard stop at 50% loss of the debit.
Consider closing the lone call if the underlying breaks down hard, leaving a pure long put position.
exit_rules: No short legs, so no assignment risk.
Close every leg by 15:00 ET on expiration day: OCC exercise-by-exception auto-exercises longs that finish $0.01 ITM, which would deliver 100 or 200 shares into the account.
Close any leg worth less than $0.05 rather than letting it expire.
assignment_risk: None from short legs; the exposure is auto-exercise of the winning long leg delivering shares. Close everything before expiry.
common_mistakes: Paying up for skewed puts and needing an outsized move just to break even; buying in high IV; holding three decaying premiums through a quiet tape.
zero_dte_notes: Same as the strap: event-window only, minutes not hours, hard time stop, greeks computed locally because Alpaca supplies none at 0DTE.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
